headline.purpose: Each window's title, written as a shell comment.

body.purpose: Prose, transcripts and tables: IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed, 1.125rem (1.0625rem on phones).

label.purpose: Keys and the status bar: uppercase with 0.06em tracking.

components.name: Primary Key
components.description: The one primary action in view, in inverse video with a phosphor halo.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1ch; padding: 0.55em 1.2ch; border: 1px solid #33ff66; background: transparent; color: #33ff66; font: 18px/1 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-key::before { content: '['; } .ds-key::after { content: ']'; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6ffb6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key-primary { background: #33ff66; color: #020805; box-shadow: 0 0 1.25rem rgb(51 255 102 / 0.32); } .ds-key-primary:hover { background: #b6ffb6; box-shadow: 0 0 1.75rem rgb(182 255 182 / 0.45); }

components.name: Key
components.description: A secondary command: the phosphor outline, deep glass under the pointer.
components.css: .ds-key-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1ch; padding: 0.55em 1.2ch; border: 1px solid #33ff66; background: transparent; color: #33ff66; text-shadow: 0 0 1px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.55), 0 0 7px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); font: 18px/1 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-key-outline::before { content: '['; } .ds-key-outline::after { content: ']'; } .ds-key-outline:hover { background: #07210f; } .ds-key-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-key-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6ffb6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Prompt
components.description: The replay's command line: a dim prompt and a bloom input that takes real commands.
components.html: tellerline:~$
components.css: .ds-prompt { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1ch; font: 18px/1.5 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; background: #020805; padding: 0.5em; } .ds-prompt-ps1 { color: #23a14b; } .ds-prompt-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #b6ffb6; caret-color: #b6ffb6; font: inherit; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgb(182 255 182 / 0.85), 0 0 14px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.5), 0 0 40px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); } .ds-prompt-input::placeholder { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: none; } .ds-prompt-input:focus { background: #07210f; } .ds-prompt-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6ffb6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: The fixed inverse bar listing the page's windows; the current one reversed back.
components.html: [tellerline]0:call*1:turn2:numbers
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: #33ff66; color: #020805; font: 14.4px/1 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-name { font-family: 'IBM 3270', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-status-item { padding: 0.25rem 0.7ch; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-status-item:hover { background: #07210f; color: #33ff66; } .ds-status-current { background: #020805; color: #33ff66; } .ds-status-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #020805; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Window Heading
components.description: Each window's title written as a shell comment, over the real command that produced it.
components.html:
# Measured by phoning it, not projected

$ python -m bench.caller --turns 220
components.css: .ds-window { background: #020805; padding: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid #0b331e; font-family: 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-cmd { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1rem + 1vw, 1.75rem); line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 400; color: #b6ffb6; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgb(182 255 182 / 0.85), 0 0 14px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.5), 0 0 40px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); } .ds-cmd-hash { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: 0 0 1px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.55), 0 0 7px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); } .ds-cmd-line { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: #33ff66; text-shadow: 0 0 1px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.55), 0 0 7px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); font-size: 17px; } .ds-dim { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: none; }

components.name: Transcript Turn
components.description: The signature replay: a timestamped caller line, its stages with milliseconds, the measured wait, and the reply printing in bloom.
components.html:
1. 00:32.3CALLERMy card ending 4217 was taken out of my bag on the bus.
  2. replied after 0.50 s · 0.91 s for the caller
  3. decidedACTION freeze card=4217 reason=stolen357 ms
  4. 00:37.0TELLERLINEI've frozen that card for you.
components.css: .ds-turn { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 1rem; background: #020805; color: #33ff66; font: 16px/1.6 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; text-shadow: 0 0 1px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.55), 0 0 7px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8ch 11ch 1fr; } .ds-t, .ds-ms { color: #1d8c4a; text-shadow: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-who { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: none; } .ds-agent { color: #33ff66; } .ds-said { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: none; } .ds-gap { padding-left: 19ch; color: #b6ffb6; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgb(182 255 182 / 0.85), 0 0 14px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.5), 0 0 40px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); } .ds-dim { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: none; } .ds-stage { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 19ch 10ch 1fr auto; font-size: 0.9em; } .ds-stage .ds-dim { grid-column: 2; } .ds-act, .ds-live { color: #b6ffb6; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgb(182 255 182 / 0.85), 0 0 14px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.5), 0 0 40px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); } .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 0.62em; height: 1.05em; margin-left: 0.1em; vertical-align: -0.15em; background: #b6ffb6; box-shadow: 0 0 2px rgb(182 255 182 / 0.85), 0 0 14px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.5), 0 0 40px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); animation: ds-blink 1.06s steps(1, end) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cursor { animation: none; } }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Measured results as plain rows: dim lower-case headings, scanline rules, tabular numbers.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; background: #020805; color: #33ff66; text-shadow: 0 0 1px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.55), 0 0 7px rgb(51 255 102 / 0.22); font: 16px/1.5 'IBM 3270 Semi-Condensed', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th { color: #23a14b; text-shadow: none; font-weight: 400; text-align: left; padding: 0.5rem 2ch 0.5rem 0; } .ds-table td { border-top: 1px solid #0b331e; padding: 0.5rem 2ch 0.5rem 0; }

narrative.overview:
The page is an operator's terminal in a midnight machine room. A real recorded call replays as a tmux-style session: every line the caller said, every route, ACTION line and millisecond prints as it happened while both voices play. Everything else on the page continues the same session: a heading is a shell comment, under it the real command that produced what follows, then that command's output. The page is read and played, never decorated; it refuses the voice-AI defaults of a glowing orb, gradient glass, an icon feature grid and invented metrics.

The world is one phosphor at several intensities on a black-green tube, behind curved CRT glass with scanlines, a fine grain and an edge fade. One dot-matrix monospace face (IBM 3270) carries everything, from the display headline to the per-stage timings; hierarchy comes from size steps, case, indentation, a timestamp gutter and dashed rules. What is active is in inverse video. States print themselves (`playing dispute`, `command not found`, `replied after 0.50 s`). Density is a working terminal's: generous between windows, tight inside them.
keyCharacteristics: One colour, P1 phosphor, at six text and surface intensities; nothing else exists.
One face, IBM 3270, in two widths: Regular for display, Semi-Condensed for everything else.
Square everything: no radius, no cards, no drop shadows; frames are 1 px lines.
Commands are bracketed keys; the active one is inverse.
Every number shown is read from exported run data, and its source command is printed above it.

rules.name: The One Phosphor Rule
rules.body: No colour outside this scale appears anywhere, not even for errors or status. Meaning comes from intensity, inverse video and words.

rules.name: The Text Floor Rule
rules.body: Text is never drawn in Afterimage. The dimmest text is Faint Phosphor (4.7:1); Afterimage is for lines, bars and glyphs that carry no reading.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every timing, count and timestamp is set with tabular numerals, so columns of milliseconds line up as a terminal's would.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is brightness. A surface never rises off the page; a line glows harder.

dos: **Do** print the command that produced a number above it, and link its result file.
**Do** keep every colour on the phosphor scale above; express state with intensity, inverse video and words.
**Do** keep text at Faint Phosphor (4.7:1) or brighter, and set timings in tabular numerals.
**Do** wrap commands only between words, and keep all eight windows reachable from the status bar and the 0-7 keys.
**Do** print motion-free under `prefers-reduced-motion`: the replay, cursor and smooth scroll all have still equivalents.
donts: **Don't** add a colour, a gradient, a rounded corner, a card or a drop shadow.
**Don't** use an orb, glass panels, an icon feature grid or an invented metric: the page's proof is a recorded call and measured runs.
**Don't** draw text in Afterimage (#176e3a); it is for lines and unplayed bars.
**Don't** type a number into the page by hand; it is read from the exported results.
